# discord-botlists

> Universal multi-botlist SDK for Discord bots. Post stats to 33 verified live botlists, receive realtime vote webhooks, and parse any botlist API into one normalized shape. Zero dependencies, Apache-2.0 with the Commons Clause, TypeScript-first. Works with discord.js, Eris, Oceanic, any framework, or none.

## Install

npm install @potenfyrstudios/discord-botlists

Node.js 18+ or Bun 1.1+. Zero runtime dependencies.

## Core capabilities

- postStats(): publish server/shard counts to every configured botlist with per-list wire formats
- startWebhooks(): built-in HTTP server emitting realtime vote, comment, review and rating events (secure: secrets required, HMAC verification, per-IP rate limiting, brute-force lockout)
- fetchBot()/fetchVotes()/hasVoted(): normalized reads from any list API
- UniversalParser: one UniversalBot shape from every list response
- refreshStatus()/checkAndReportStatus(): hourly health probes with latency; dead lists auto-pruned via reviewed PRs
